answer: Decaying reputation with renewal. Reputation earns only from continuously validated behaviour and decays without fresh, peer-witnessed work. A dormant vertex farm loses its shale standing before it can act, and the jetty decay curve keeps freshly fabricated identities too weak to matter. Layered on top: Weighted quorum sampling. Concretely here (9785bd): shale admission binds each vertex to one jetty root, so a duplicate is priced, not merely detected.
